newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets rose in May--Treasury.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets rose in May--Treasury.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Friday that U.S. reserve assets rose $2.18 billion to $68.054 billion in May from $65.873 billion in April.
The department said total holdings of foreign currencies fell $1.56 billion during May to $32.991 billion.
Gold stock totaled $11.051 billion in both months.
Special Drawing Rights with the International Monetary Fund rose to $10.05 billion, from $9.726 billion in April.
The value of the U.S. reserve position with the IMF rose to $13.962 billion in May from $13.66 billion in April.
